subject: Vanta renewal: scope adjustments, evidence credits, and contract hold
body:
From: Emma Owens <emma.owens@vanta.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, contracts@vanta.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal quote + proposed scope for Redwood Inference (SOC 2 bundle)

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is the renewal proposal for Redwood's SOC 2 and Trust Center coverage. Key points in this version: a single-platform price for continuous evidence collection + 1 manual attestation run per year; pricing assumes the same number of integrations and 100 active evidence owners.

Attachments: Vanta_Renewal_Quote_Redwood_v2.pdf (see summary page for line items)

Before I finalize for legal, quick questions:
- Would you like us to include the optional onboarding retainer (2 week dedicated success engineer) on this quote?
- Any anticipated changes to number of evidence owners or integrations this year? That will change seat/pricing tiers.

If helpful I can turn this into a DocuSign today once you confirm the onboarding add-on.

Best,
Emma Owens
Enterprise Account Executive | Vanta
emma.owens@vanta.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

-----

On Thu, 30 Sep 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Owens <emma.owens@vanta.com> wrote:
> Hi Rishi —
>
> Attached is the renewal proposal...

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Owens <emma.owens@vanta.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + proposed scope for Redwood Inference (SOC 2 bundle)

Emma — thanks for the fast turn. A few internal asks before we move to DocuSign: 

1) Evidence ownership credit: we want a credit/price offset for the 30% of controls we plan to move to internal automation (our infra team will push evidence directly into your API). Please show a line item for evidence-owner count and a delta for evidence-handback credits.

2) Audit run frequency: we'd like the option to drop from 1 manual attestation to a self-service attestation unless a major product change triggers a manual run. That should reduce cost — can you price both options?

3) Data retention clause: we need assurance that historical evidence (raw logs) that Vanta ingests will be retained for 24 months for incident response. If this requires a paid add-on, detail the cost.

4) Onboarding: we'll accept the 2-week success engineer, but want the retainer included as a one-time fee rather than amortized monthly.

Monica — can you sketch the budget owner/approval path for this? Marcus — FYI on the retention ask (possible S3 lifecycle/legal constraints).

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

> On Sep 30, 2026, at 09:12, Emma Owens <emma.owens@vanta.com> wrote:
> > Attached is the renewal proposal...

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:18:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + proposed scope for Redwood Inference (SOC 2 bundle)

Rishi / team —

Quick cost modeling attached (renewal-costs-breakdown.xlsx). High-level: the base renewal price gets us continuous monitoring + 1 manual attestation. If we:

- Reduce manual attestations to self-service, saves ~18% annually.
- Apply evidence-owner credits for the 30% we offload (per Emma's comments), saves ~7% if Vanta agrees.
- Convert onboarding retainer to one-time fee, moves ~$12k from OPEX to one-time CAPEX in our spreadsheet.

Budget owner is Product Ops (Lisa Huang). I can coordinate PO routing — we have a PO window next week if we want to lock 2027 pricing.

Attachment: renewal-costs-breakdown.xlsx

Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---

From: Emma Owens <emma.owens@vanta.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@vanta.com, vendor-legal@vanta.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:22:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + proposed scope for Redwood Inference (SOC 2 bundle)

Thanks for the clear asks — we've updated the quote and attached version 3.

Summary of changes in v3: 
- Added a line item showing "evidence-owner credits" as a negative line tied to the evidence owner count (we priced the 30% reduction at a 7% offset as a starting point — see page 2).
- Added optional "self-service attestation" SKU with pricing for both annual and per-change triggers.
- Onboarding retainer is shown as a one-time fee per your request.
- Data retention: standard retention is 12 months; extended retention to 24 months is an add-on we can do at $4,500/year. We're flagging this for vendor-legal to confirm data custody requirements.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/recipient/sign/ABCDEF123456 (opens the revised SOW + order form).

Note on legal redlines: vendor-legal has flagged the data-processing addendum and liability cap, and contracts@vanta.com will accept limited changes. If your legal team needs edits, please mark them in the attached "requested_sow_changes.docx" and I'll route them to vendor-legal.

Attachments: Vanta_Renewal_Quote_Redwood_v3.pdf, requested_sow_changes.docx

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Emma

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + proposed scope for Redwood Inference (SOC 2 bundle)

Thanks for the thread. A couple of legal points before we sign: 

1) Please do not click the DocuSign link yet — we'll need to review the redlines. I've asked vendor-legal for their last draft; until we reconcile the DPA language we should not execute.

2) Data retention: we need Vanta to accept that any raw logs ingested under our account remain under our control and that deletion requests originate from Redwood only. Add a clause that Vanta will provide an export on request in a standardized format within 7 business days.

3) Liability cap: ask them to align the cap to 12 months of fees for the subscription line item only — we'll accept standard exclusions.

Marcus — please confirm whether the 24-month retention add-on will require additional storage approval on our side (I suspect some S3 lifecycle policy changes).

Rishi / Monica — I'll return redlined SOW comments by EOD Wednesday. For procurement: Monica, please pause PO submission until legal signs off.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

- Laura to send redlined SOW by EOD Wed.
